2c317eb7111ef4748ed97f071de1a9d4b3c3e2be: It is natural to feel discouraged when things do not go as planned, but the Gita suggests that our focus should remain on the effort itself rather than the outcome [2.47]. You have the right to perform your duties, but you are not entitled to control the results of your actions [2.47]. It can be helpful to try to remain balanced, treating both success and failure with the same sense of composure [2.48]. This state of equanimity is described as a form of yoga [2.48]. The text suggests that one might engage in their responsibilities without being overly concerned with gain or loss, victory or defeat [2.38]. By shifting your perspective to focus on the act of studying rather than the grade, you might find a way to move forward without being weighed down by the result [2.38].
